ABRT Saturday Ride (Davidsonville)

Davidsonville, MD · Road

ABRT Saturday Ride (Davidsonville) is a road group ride in Davidsonville, MD. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Davidsonville Road Park and Ride (MD 424 at US 50).

How we know

ABRT's public Google Calendar lists the Saturday Ride weekly from Sat Oct 3 through Nov 28, 2026 at 9:00 am; its training-rides page gives the 8, 9 and 10 am seasons (both fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

An open ride, not sanctioned or supported by ABRT. No earbuds. Know the route or bring a GPS file. Time moves to 10:00 am for the winter (December); the page does not give the 2026 switch date.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16-18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @abrtcycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the ABRT Saturday Ride (Davidsonville) group ride

The Annapolis area's long-running Saturday group ride, more than 30 years old. The A ride is 60 miles to North Beach at 18-21+ mph and the B ride is 42 miles to Deale at 16-18 mph. There are no regroup points on the A ride, and riders should expect to ride alone if they get dropped.
